How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for CURAJ Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at CURAJ?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Central University of Rajasthan is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. in Chemistry with at least 55% marks or an equivalent CGPA and have qualified the CSIR-UGC NET/GATE/equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted via email. Ensure all required documents are attached and the subject line clearly states the post applied for.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow position at the Central University of Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a screening followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for CURAJ Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, labeled as 'Official Notification PDF'.

faq.question: Q9. Does CURAJ offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Age relaxation details are not explicitly mentioned in the provided data, so it is advisable to refer to the official notification for specific information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at CURAJ is a contractual role.
